summary: Digital Brands Group filed an 8-K disclosing an at-the-market issuance sales agreement with Aegis Capital Corp., enabling the sale of up to $100 million of common stock under an existing shelf registration statement. This is a routine capital-markets financing arrangement, not an event-driven special situation. No special situation elements such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring are present. The filing is a standard current report for a material definitive agreement. Therefore, this filing does not meet the criteria for a special situation classification.
